verdicts.explanation: The paper states s = 1.0 × 10⁻³ S/cm for Li3P in the Figure 2 text, and says the dataset conductivities are experimental room-temperature values compiled from previous literature (Table S1), so literature_cited and RT are supported and the numeric temperature is correctly null.

The paper states s = 2.085 × 10⁻⁴ S/cm for b-Li3N in the same Figure 2 sentence, within the paper's room-temperature literature-compiled dataset, so the value, unit, origin and null numeric temperature are all consistent with the paper.
